messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert 3087654321 — streaming_token_p99 spike detected for streaming-inference-prod (us-west-2). Current p99=9.2s, baseline ~2.4s. Spike started around 2026-03-14T21:58Z during recent quant calibration rollout window.

Alex K: paging oncall @Priya S — seeing sustained tail. Stalls on streaming side, many requests waiting on kv-cache dequeue + dequant. Traces show long waits in runtime::dequantize_kv for int8 kernel path.

Priya S: oncall ack. I'm on it. @Simon T fyi in case we need to adjust capacity or rollback infra changes.

Maria L: CS: flagged P2 for customer CS-9901; they're reporting partial streams and delays ~5–10s.

Priya S: initial hunch: new int8 calibration profile cal-v2026-03-14-rc4 pushed at ~21:55Z may have changed kernel selection heuristics for some tensor shapes -> slower dequant loops for long contexts.

Alex K: repro from traces: cluster of long-context requests with kv hits show per-layer dequant pauses accumulating. stack shows dequantize_kv on hot path, repeated across layers.

Priya S: immediate plan: 1) apply routing override to force fp16 variant for streaming while we test rollback 2) roll back calibration to cal-v2026-03-06-stable if safe 3) monitor p95/p99 and streaming stall metrics closely.

Simon T: thumbs up. I'll be ready to spin up extra fp16 workers if routing override causes capacity pressure.

Priya S: running probes now. Commands:
```
redwoodctl metrics tail --env prod --metric streaming_token_p99,streaming_kv_dequeue_time --since 30m
redwoodctl traces query --service streaming-runtime --filter "tag:calibration=cal-v2026-03-14-rc4" --limit 100
```

deploy-bot: Rollout event: model=gpt-large quant=int8 calibration=cal-v2026-03-14-rc4 rollout=100% by @ml-release at 2026-03-14T21:55:12Z

Priya S: confirmed ~100% of gpt-large streaming traffic on the new cal-v2026-03-14-rc4. No automatic fallback fired.

Priya S: applying fp16 routing override (fast):
```
redwoodctl route set --route streaming --model gpt-large --variant gpt-large-fp16 --priority 1 --until 2026-03-14T22:30Z
```

ops-note: Priya S set route override for streaming -> gpt-large-fp16 :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: route update applied id=route-100112 by Priya S at 2026-03-14T22:01:04Z

Priya S: starting calibration rollback deployment (dry-run then apply):
```
redwoodctl profiles swap --model gpt-large --from cal-v2026-03-14-rc4 --to cal-v2026-03-06-stable --dry-run
redwoodctl profiles swap --model gpt-large --from cal-v2026-03-14-rc4 --to cal-v2026-03-06-stable
```

Priya S: dry-run OK, shapes compatible. rollback job queued id job-9912, rolling across 6 clusters with canaries.

Alex K: note: check for any token-level cost regressions; also tag traces for long-context tests.

Priya S: after fp16 override p99 improved quickly: global p99 dropped from 9.2s -> 3.4s within ~90s. streaming_kv_dequeue_time median still slightly high but tail reduced.

Maria L: CS-9901 notified of mitigation and expected improvement window. They acknowledged and will monitor.

deploy-bot: job-9912 applied to us-west-2-a (canary) — success at 2026-03-14T22:05:30Z

Priya S: canary metrics look healthy — p99 us-west-2-a down to 2.6s. proceeding to rest of clusters.

deploy-bot: job-9912 applied to us-west-2-b,c, us-east-1a, eu-west-1a, ap-south-1a — all success. global rollback complete at 2026-03-14T22:14:18Z

Simon T: ap-south-1 capacity note: had to spin 2 small fp16 warmers during canary, but within limits. playbook update needed.

Priya S: removing fp16 override in 5m if stable. current metrics: global streaming_token_p99=2.5s, p95=1.0s, streaming stall rate back to baseline. starting 30m cooldown and extended monitoring.

Alex K: preliminary root cause: cal-v2026-03-14-rc4 changed kernel selection for int8 dequant path for some KV shapes, causing per-layer latency increases that amplified at p99 for long-context streaming. rollback reverted kernel choices.

Maria L: sent CS follow-up to CS-9901 with explanation, mitigation steps, and note that we're preparing a postmortem.

Priya S: follow-ups assigned: Alex K -> collect trace bundle + perf repro (ticket INF-4098); Maria L -> customer comms + timeline (ticket CS-9933); Simon T -> infra playbook update + fp16 pre-warm plan (ticket INF-4099); Priya S -> incident postmortem (incident-3087654321) due in 48h.

Alex K: closing after 30m stable window. Nice coordination. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Monitoring note: entering 30m cooldown for incident 3087654321. Auto-close if metrics remain stable.

Priya S: observed stability through cooldown. No further pages. Thread closed — postmortem to follow.
